rankings.howCalculatedIntro: Rankings are computed from five components plus a roster talent prior that tapers off as the season progresses. Each component is normalised relative to the rest of the league (best team = 1.0, worst = 0.0) before weighting, so rankings reflect where a team stands right now.
rankings.componentPointsDesc: Points earned divided by maximum possible (games played × 2). The primary measure of season-long success.
rankings.componentL10Desc: Same formula applied to the last 10 games only. This is what moves rankings week to week — a hot team climbs, a cold team falls regardless of earlier results.
rankings.componentGDDesc: Goals scored minus goals allowed per game. Teams that win convincingly rank higher than teams that constantly squeak by one goal.
rankings.componentXGFDesc: Expected goals for % at even strength — the share of shot quality a team generates versus allows at 5-on-5. Filters out goaltending and shooting luck that inflate or deflate raw goal totals.
rankings.componentSPDesc: Average of power play % and penalty kill %. Weighted lower than even-strength play because special teams frequency and opponent quality vary.
rankings.componentWARDesc: Sum of the top-18 skaters' Wins Above Replacement plus the starter's Goals Saved Above Expected. Weighted at 15% at game 0, tapering to 0% by game 20. Ensures pre-season and early-season rankings reflect roster quality rather than a handful of fluky results.
rankings.howCalculatedFootnote: xGF% and Roster WAR show — until the first nightly pipeline run populates them. All other components still produce a valid rank.

advanced.shotExplainFull: Corsi For% (CF%) approximates all shot attempts using shots on goal + blocked shots from the NHL realtime report. Fenwick For% (FF%) uses shots on goal only, excluding blocked shots. Both measure territorial control — ≥50% means {{abbr}} is generating more attempts than opponents.
advanced.shotExplainProxy: Shot For% is a SOG-based proxy. Realtime blocked shot data unavailable for this game type.
advanced.cfNote: All shot attempts for ÷ total. ≥50% = territorial control
advanced.ffNote: Unblocked attempts for ÷ total. Filters out shot-blocking luck
advanced.proxyNote: SOG for ÷ total SOG. ≥50% = outshooting opponents
advanced.blockedForNote: Shots blocked by {{abbr}} skaters per game
advanced.blockedAgainstNote: {{abbr}} shots blocked by opponents per game
advanced.possessionNote: Time with puck ÷ total play time
advanced.pdoExplain: PDO = team shooting% + save% × 100. League average = 100. Values above 102 suggest positive puck luck likely to regress; below 98 suggest negative luck. Useful for identifying unsustainable streaks.
advanced.netPpExplain: Net PP% excludes goals where the opposing team was also shorthanded simultaneously.
advanced.netPkExplain: Net PK% excludes goals while both teams were shorthanded simultaneously.
advanced.loadingSub: These come from the NHL stats API and may take a moment.

boxscore.shotAttemptsHelp: Corsi: all shot attempts including misses and blocks. Best possession proxy.
boxscore.xgHelpMoneyPuck: MoneyPuck 5v5 expected goals — their full xG model including shot quality, traffic, and pre-shot movement. Available a few hours after game end.
boxscore.xgHelpEstimate: xG estimated from shot distance and angle (live estimate). Replaced by MoneyPuck's full model once the game ends.

goalieCard.gsaxSeasonHelp: Regular season goals saved above expected (MoneyPuck flurry-adjusted xGoals model). Shown year-round as the larger sample is more reliable than playoff sample sizes. Positive = saving more goals than an average goalie on the same shots. {{gpNote}}

ppkShared.durationHelp: Duration — time in seconds between the first and last tracked play of this opportunity. Scores early = shorter duration. May be shorter than the full 2-minute penalty if there were no events near the start or end.

ppAnalysis.xgHelp: Expected goals on PP shots — estimated from shot distance and angle. Higher = better quality looks.
ppAnalysis.unitNote: Units inferred from play-by-play — players who didn't touch the puck may not appear. Some PPs may be untagged if there wasn't enough data to identify the unit.

pkAnalysis.xgaHelp: Expected goals against on PK shots — estimated from shot distance and angle. Lower is better.
pkAnalysis.unitNote: Units inferred from play-by-play — players who didn't touch the puck may not appear.

goalie.gsaxCaption: Goals saved above expected — flurry-adjusted xGoals model
goalie.tip5v5SvPct: Save percentage at even strength (5-on-5 only). Removes special teams situations which can skew overall SV%. The most stable indicator of true goaltending ability.
goalie.tipHdSvPct: Save percentage on high-danger shots — taken within ~15 feet of the net. The hardest shots to stop; the best quality-adjusted goalie metric.
goalie.tipMdSvPct: Save percentage on medium-danger shots (15–30 feet from net). Complements HD SV% for a fuller picture of save quality across shot locations.
goalie.tipPkSvPct: Save percentage while shorthanded. Penalty kill goaltending requires different positioning — some goalies are significantly better or worse in this situation than at even strength.

skater.warTip: Wins Above Replacement (beta). EV component uses 5v5 RAPM — ridge regression across 3 seasons of league-wide shift and shot data, controlling for teammates and opponents. PP/PK and finishing components are xGoals-based from MoneyPuck. RAPM is 5v5 only; special teams remain approximate. Zone-start adjustment in development — defensive defensemen may be slightly undervalued in current model. Validated periodically vs Evolving Hockey public RAPM.
skater.tipEvXgfPct: On-ice expected goals for % at 5-on-5. The share of total shot quality generated while this player is on the ice — above 50% means the team outshoots opponents in quality with him on the ice. Team metric, not individual.
skater.tipXgf60: Individual expected goals generated per 60 minutes — the shot quality this player personally produces, based on shot location and type. Measures how dangerous their own shots are, independent of linemates.
skater.tipXga60: On-ice expected goals against per 60 minutes at 5-on-5. Measures how many quality chances opponents generate while this player is on the ice — lower is better. Team metric reflecting the full line's defensive performance.
skater.tipHdca60: High-danger chances against per 60 minutes at 5-on-5. Shots from the slot and crease — the most likely to result in goals. Lower is better.
skater.tipGoals60: Goals scored per 60 minutes of ice time. Rate-adjusts for playing time so a player with 15 min/game and one with 22 min/game can be compared fairly.
skater.tipA160: Primary (first) assists per 60 minutes. First assists directly set up the goal scorer and are more meaningful than secondary assists, which can be coincidental.
skater.tipPpToi: Power play ice time this season. Presence here means the player has enough PP time for a reliable PP metric — see the Power Play percentile bar below.
skater.tipPkToi: Penalty kill ice time this season. Presence here means the player has enough PK time for a reliable PK metric — see the Penalty Kill percentile bar below.

resultsVsProcess.emptyState: Not enough games yet for a reliable read.
resultsVsProcess.emptyStateSub: Needs a minimum sample of games played this season.
resultsVsProcess.tipOnIceGf: On-ice goals-for percentage at 5-on-5 -- the share of goals scored (not just shot attempts/quality) while this player is on the ice. The 'results' side of this pairing.
resultsVsProcess.tipGapVsProcess: On-Ice GF% minus EV xGF% (the process/shot-quality side, shown above in the percentile rankings). A large positive or negative gap suggests results are running hotter or colder than the underlying process -- often a sign of unsustainable luck rather than true talent.

contract.valueTooltipBlended: Blended score: 60% points per $1M (projected to 82 GP) + 40% WAR per $1M (scaled). WAR uses 5v5 RAPM (beta) + PP/PK/finishing components — captures two-way value points miss. Defensive specialists and shutdown players score higher here than on a pure points basis. Scale: ≥8.0 Exceptional · ≥5.0 Great · ≥3.0 Good · ≥1.8 Fair · ≥1.0 Below avg · <1.0 Overpaid. ELC contracts excluded.
contract.valueTooltipPointsOnly: Points per $1M of cap hit (projected to 82 games). WAR data unavailable for this player — using points only. Scale: ≥8.0 Exceptional · ≥5.0 Great · ≥3.0 Good · ≥1.8 Fair · ≥1.0 Below avg · <1.0 Overpaid. ELC contracts excluded.
contract.p60Tip: Points per 60 minutes of ice time. Removes ice time differences — a player with 10 pts in 12 min/game produces at a very different rate than 10 pts in 22 min/game. League avg for top-6 forwards: ~2.0–3.5.
contract.elcTip: Entry Level Contracts have a league-mandated cap hit ($775K–$925K) that doesn't reflect market value, so the blended value comparison isn't meaningful.
contract.elcTipShort: ELC cap hits are league-mandated and don't reflect market value.
contract.goalieValueTip: Goals saved above expected (GSAX) per $1M of cap hit. GSAX accounts for shot quality and volume — a positive number means the goalie saved more goals than an average goalie would have on the same shots. Dividing by cap hit shows how much of that value you're getting per dollar. Scale: ≥4.0 Exceptional · ≥2.0 Great · ≥0.0 Fair · ≥-2.0 Below avg · <-2.0 Overpaid. ELC goalies excluded.
